name: Video Wallpaper Manager
author: p3lusa
description: Video-wallpaper manager for Omarchy on the OWE engine (owed): each clip pairs with its own theme, so video, palette and wallpaper change together. Library TUI with poster thumbnails (browse, preview, add, remove, re-extract palette), instant prev/next cycle hotkeys, and per-clip themes created and reaped automatically. Rendering, VAAPI decode and pause policies come from owe (install: omarchy pkg add owe).
